_README: Long-term (monthly) private rentals — managed manually here. These are NOT PadSplit co-living rooms and are NOT touched by the scraper. Applications go through each unit's TurboTenant link (applyUrl). Add photos to the photos[] array when ready. Photos must be interiors only — no exterior, aerial, drone, or street-facing shots, and no filenames that identify a community.
